findings.evidence: Message template restates `<type>(<scope>): <summary>` plus a what/why body, which step 6 and the spec section already require.
findings.fix: Keep the worked messages; move the skeleton template to the end of references/commit-message-template.md as an optional reminder, or delete it and add a row to docs/audit/recovery/commit-work/record.md, since the model reliably produces that skeleton unprompted.

findings.evidence: The skill is a process workflow, but step 3 packs index selection, overlap checks, staging methods and cleanup into one paragraph instead of phased checkpoints.
findings.fix: Split step 3 into numbered checkpoints (choose the index, stage, review the overlap) while keeping the same commands and the behavior-split rule.

findings.evidence: Step 6 says to read references/commit-message-template.md only when the repository sets message rules, then also when the agent merely wants worked messages or the step 8 report block.
findings.fix: Gate the worked messages and report block on a concrete case (a multi-line body, a footer beyond BREAKING CHANGE, or the step 8 report), and say not to load the file for a one-line message in a repository with no rules.

findings.evidence: Step 5 says to find the check in package.json scripts, Makefile targets or the CI config, a menu of equal places rather than one default.
findings.fix: Default to the repository's test script for the touched paths, then its lint script, then its build script, and look at CI only when none of those exists.

findings.evidence: The file has 10 should-trigger and 10 should-not-trigger queries, but no train/validation split, and near-miss coverage stops at history edits, PRs and merge conflicts.
findings.fix: Add a fixed train/validation split and near-misses such as amending a message, reverting one commit, or writing a changelog from commits already made.

findings.evidence: Step 3 says to copy the diff to pick.diff and delete whole hunks, but never says to keep the diff and index header lines; deleting them makes git apply --cached --check fail.
findings.fix: State that pick.diff keeps the diff --git, index and ---/+++ header lines and drops only whole @@ hunks, and that a failed --check means stop and ask rather than edit the hunk.

findings.evidence: The collect step names only .github/pull_request_template.md and .github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/, while GitHub also reads a template in the repository root or docs/.
findings.fix: Add the root and docs/ locations GitHub documents, and keep the existing .github paths.
